name: Wiz Checkout Upsell
summary: Shopify checkout and post-purchase app from Skai Lama: upsells, volume discounts, subscription upgrades and free gifts, plus checkout banners, trust badges, input fields and gift messages, with thank-you and order status page offers behind them.
best_for: shopify merchants who want checkout-stage upsells, banners, trust badges and gift messages alongside post-purchase and thank-you page offers from a single app, and whose order volume already makes $99 a month a rounding error
skip_if: you were budgeting the $49 tier and expected checkout upsells with it — that plan is post-purchase only — or you want to test the idea at no cost first, because there is no free plan here
honest_knock: The name says checkout, but the $49 Essential plan does not include checkout upsells. That tier is post-purchase, thank-you page and order status page only, and the listing explicitly marks it as not applicable for Shopify Plus. Everything the app is named after — checkout upsells, checkout banners and trust badges, input fields, gift messages, free gifts at checkout — starts on the $99 Plus Growth plan. There is no free plan either, only a 14-day trial; as of 19 September that tier carries a BFCM offer of $1 for the first month, undated, so today the cheapest honest look at checkout upsells is a dollar and after this promotion it is $99 a month again. And A/B testing across all extensions, the feature you would want precisely to prove that $99 was worth it, sits one rung higher again at $199 — even though the listing advertises built-in A/B testing in its own highlights.

pricing.notes: (prices re-verified 2026-09-19 on apps.shopify.com/checkout-pro; the ladder is unchanged since 2 September, one promotion is new) Three tiers, billed in USD every 30 days, each with a 14-day free trial and no free plan. Essential is $49 a month and covers post-purchase upsell funnels, thank-you page upsells and customization, order status page upsells and a review block, and all shipping and payment customizations; the listing marks that tier as not applicable for Shopify Plus. Plus Growth is $99 a month, or $999 a year (the listing says that saves 16%), and is the tier that opens the checkout itself: checkout upsells, subscription upgrades, checkout banners, reviews and trust badges, checkout input fields and gift messages, a checkout discount list and free gifts, on top of everything in Essential. That card now also carries a BFCM offer — "Pay only $1 for first month!" — with no end date printed beside it. Checkout concierge is $199 a month or $1,999 a year (save 16%) and adds custom onboarding and launch, A/B testing and analysis across all extensions, monthly performance review calls and custom extension development.

compare_with.name: AfterSell
compare_with.why: Both are Shopify upsell apps, and AfterSell is the broader, longer-established name for post-purchase and thank-you page offers. Wiz splits its ladder differently: $49 buys the post-purchase half only, and the checkout-stage editing that gives the app its name starts at $99. So compare on the tier you would actually buy. If post-purchase offers are the goal, weigh AfterSell against the $49 plan; if you want to rewrite the checkout page itself, weigh it against $99 and price the difference.
